title: @sigstore/oci sends the registry Authorization header to a cross-host blob-upload Location (CVE-2026-118763)
description: @sigstore/oci versions prior to 0.7.2 improperly send the registry Authorization header to a cross-host blob-upload Location URL. This occurs because the Authorization header is set as a default on the HTTP client and is attached to all requests, including those redirected to a different host for blob uploads. The vulnerability allows a malicious or compromised registry to capture credentials by redirecting blob uploads to an attacker-controlled host.
